context.transcript:
Hi Louisa, it's Jimmy from BAJ Kitchen Remodeling.
I want to give you an update on your kitchen renovations.
We've run into a small problem.
The company we ordered the tiles from called to say their deliveries are behind schedule.
They can't send us the new floor tiles until the end of the week.
But there is some good news.
Tomorrow we'll get started removing the wood flooring that's currently there.
Also, because the tile company is sorry for the inconvenience, they've offered a special discount of 20% off your order.

但有个好消息。
明天我们将开始拆除目前存在的木地板。
